statement: On a finite graph G with q=3 and Potts weight exp(K sum_{uv in E} 1_{sigma_u=sigma_v}), fixed color-1 boundary B, conditional on A={v:sigma_v in {1,2}}, B subset A, the tau=+1/-1 color labels on A have Ising law on G[A] with coupling J=K/2 and + boundary B; the A marginal is proportional to exp(K|E(A^c)|+K|E(A)|/2) Z_Ising(G[A],K/2,+B).
assumptions: Finite simple graph; K>0; all vertices in B fixed to color 1; A includes B.
source: Own finite-graph expansion in ATTEMPT.md; conventional Potts definition anchored to Duminil-Copin arXiv:1707.00520 pp.3-4 after K=q beta/(q-1).
proof: For edges in A, delta_{sigma_u,sigma_v}=(1+tau_u tau_v)/2; for edges in A^c delta=1; crossing edges delta=0. Sum and exponentiate, then sum over tau.
remaining_gap: No uniform critical bound on coupled A/Ising order; no C0048 proof.
